Class MemberItem

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.intellij.tools.java.codemodel.MemberItem
public class MemberItem extends Object
Lightweight, token-efficient descriptor representing a member (method, constructor, field, property, or nested type) across any JVM language (Java, Kotlin, Groovy, Scala) within the IntelliJ IDEA project model and index.

Unlike legacy models, this DTO carries zero redundant URLs or platform SPI handles. It provides the canonical member FQN, simple name, element kind, source language, full human-readable signature, return type, modifiers, and inheritance origin.

Author:
anahata
